description: Deterministic coursework candidate set for M4 ranking integration.

selection.method: First five agent IDs in ascending order; four policies and four non-policy clients per agent

field_lineage.synthetic_record_notice: Customer and policy records are coursework demonstration records generated from source-derived agent and product distributions; they are not individual Kaggle customer or policy records.

transformation_rules.policy_expected_contribution: premium multiplied by the agent historical conversion rate
transformation_rules.client_expected_contribution: client premium multiplied by the agent retention rate
transformation_rules.urgency: Policy due-date bands or client renewal/follow-up tags, normalised to 0-1
transformation_rules.actionability: Awaiting-documents/underwriting status or client follow-up tags, normalised to 0-1
transformation_rules.business_fit: Base 0.4 plus product-specialty, need-category, and high-value matches, capped at 1
transformation_rules.eligibility: Pending positive-premium policy, or active/actionable client
transformation_rules.permission: Candidate record belongs to the scenario agent
transformation_rules.reference_relevance: Deterministic 0-3 coursework label from stated operational thresholds

limitations: Reference relevance grades validate the coursework pipeline only and are not production labels.
Expected contribution is a transparent rule-based estimate, not a trained probability prediction.
